reviews.title: Has potential
reviews.text:
This game has so much potential and would be a long term game if not for its brutal pace. Half the people that come into my gym want to workout on equipment I don’t have. Then once I finally work up to getting a machine, boom half the people that come in want the next machine. 

I just reached level 12 and was excited for the pro club, but it costs 246 cash, which will probably take me years to attain. Let’s not forget that I need 84 cash to expand my gym, which I really am in need of. I always feel like I’m 2 steps behind in the game and it takes so long to make enough money even for one machine. This game actually stresses me out a bit because you can never get ahead and really design a club and manage it. 

I assume the goal is to stress me out so much that I start purchasing upgrades, but no thanks, they make enough off the annoying in game ads already. Like I said, has potential, but this game annoys me more than it relaxes me

reviews.title: Many issues.
reviews.text:
Why do the customers come in asking for things I DONT have. I’m level 14, every single customer comes in asking for the dumbells when I don’t have them. And it’s not like I can just buy it either, because it’s 14,000 and it takes days to even get up to 5,000.
Also, the wait times. If I “show a customer the door” because I don’t have what they need, I have to wait 30 MINUTES to get another customer?? Sometimes I just close the app and not open it for days because it’s annoying to “play.”
And the ads. Sometimes upon opening the app, it’ll play an ad immediately. Or play an ad in the middle of doing something. Like a customer comes in and I click them to see what they need, I can’t put them on a machine for over a minute because an ad popped up. And the ads? Most of them have been unskippable and all are too long. It’s quicker to close and reopen the app when an ad comes up than to sit and watch the ad.

And in the game there was a notification saying “-after a long break, we have returned to work on the project. Now we devote more time, strength and energy to make the game better, more interesting and faster.”
I find it hard to believe that any of that has and/or will happen.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text:
I like the concept of this game and some of the execution. I don’t even mind the wait times everyone complains about. What I do mind is that it feels like almost every time I do something after a pause, I’m hit with an ad before I can finish. Sometimes, I will watch an ad to speed up a wait time and it will play most of the ad (sometimes they are a full minute) and then crash the app and I don’t get credit for watching. 

Other games I have played with ads offer an option to purchase ad-free experiences and I would consider that. I am lvl18, more than halfway to 19, and if I were not getting cash back from swagbucks for leveling, I would have quit a while ago. 

The other thing reviewers have complained about, which I absolutely agree with, is you need new equipment before you can afford it sometimes. I’ve had two customers in my gym for at least three real world days because I cannot afford the equipment they want. You cannot make enough money to do all the things available in this game. Maybe if you maxed out some things you could, but what would be the point then?

reviews.title: It could be a way better game.
reviews.text:
Wait times for everything is just way too long. I’ve seen from old reviews that its been a problem for years. I just started playing the game and i’m level 13 and it already feels super long for customers to finish their workouts, I couldn’t imagine how long it would take 10 levels from now. 

Another thing is the prices and materials. It already takes about 10k coins to buy anything and it takes awhile to get 10k. The storage for materials honestly shouldn't have a max, you should be able to hold way more than 30-40 materials. I know you have to upgrade it but it takes materials that I can’t even get, it’s a game you pretty much have to spend money on to progress unless if you wanna play for years really. 

I’ve also completed some of the trials and it didn’t give me a single reward for the ones that I finished. 

This game is just too much of a grind for me. Theres very little progress for a lot of time played. This game could be way better if the wait times were way shorter and everything was a bit cheaper so you don’t have to spend money to progress.
